messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert fired -> P0: inference-gateway prod-usw2 high 5xx error rate. current 5xx_rate=18% over 60s, latency p95=880ms. impact: customer-facing generation endpoints. incident link: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

Eli: acked. I'm on it — taking ownership. tagging @Priya for infra changes and @Jon for logs/metrics.

Priya: oncall infra here. quick check: no autoscale events in the last 15m. I see a deployment finished ~10m ago (deploy-bot below).

deploy-bot: deploy event: image=redwood/inference:release-2026-03-15-297, env=prod-usw2, started=1765554200, finished=1765554255, tags=[canary:true].

Jon: looking at Grafana -> https://grafana.example/d/inference/5xx-rate?orgId=1&var-region=usw2. Spike aligns with deploy finish (1765554255). Traces show increased 502s at the gateway and downstream 504s from kv-cache layer. Logs: 502s show "kv-cache read timeout" and "kvcache shard busy".

Eli: ok, let's follow the canary rollback path in runbook. Steps: 1) Stop routing to canary pool 2) Scale up stable pool by +30% 3) Kick warmup on new nodes 4) If still bad, revert release.

Priya: running step 1 -> disabling canary routing via router CLI.

Priya: ```
# remove canary weight
routerctl set-weight --service inference-gateway --pool canary --weight 0 --reason "PD: 5xx spike"
routerctl get-weights --service inference-gateway
```

Priya: canary weight now 0. Routing should shift to stable pools.

Jon: after canary cut, 5xx down from 18% -> 12% in ~45s. KV-cache errors still present but less frequent. Noticed an increase in open connections on stable pool hosts.

Eli: Priya, can you scale stable pool asap? Use infra CLI to add nodes and bump instance_count.

Priya: scaling stable pool +3 nodes. Command: ```infractl scale --env prod-usw2 --pool inference-stable --delta +3```

deploy-bot: scale job queued (job id scale-789). Expected ready ~120s.

Maya: product check — support reports two enterprise customers (acme-corp, bluefin) getting timeouts in last 8 mins, some requests failing with 502. I'm pinging account teams.

Jon: after scale started, p95 latency drops to 420ms, 5xx -> 4.5% in next 90s. KV-cache warnings still show occasional "eviction stall" traces.

Eli: good progress. leave scaling to finish. If 5xx < 1% and key customers stable, we can call this mitigated. Otherwise plan to revert release.

Priya: scale finished, new nodes healthy and warmed.

Jon: 5xx at 0.9% and p95=210ms. No new spikes in logs for kv-cache. ACME and Bluefin reported recovery.

Eli: marking incident as mitigated. Not marking resolved until we confirm stable for 30m and open an incident ticket for postmortem.

pagerbot: PD: Incident INC12345 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated by on-call. Escalation canceled.

Maya: capturing customer impact and timeline for postmortem. I'll open the incident doc and assign owners: root cause triage to Jon+Priya, postmortem writeup to Maya.

Eli: +1. Next steps: collect logs, full timeline, prove canary change caused spike (compare traces), confirm no cascading config change. If revert required next time, automating immediate canary cutoff should be considered.

Jon: grabbing trace bundles and will attach to the incident doc: https://docs.example/incidents/INC12345.

Priya: adding follow-up infra action: add additional KV-cache shard metrics and alert around "shard busy" > threshold to catch early.

Eli: thanks team. handing off rotation: I'll note this in oncall notes and hand to next oncall @Priya in ~15m.

Maya: closing the thread for live mitigation. We'll meet in postmortem channel in 2h. :white_check_mark:
